chapter_theme: Salokam, dwelling in the Lord's world: the states of release named salokam, samipam and sarupam are gained through sariyai and the paths after it, and in kiriyai the mind becomes the temple and the grades of initiation end in samadhi.
structure_note: 1507 matches the states to the paths; 1508 lists the stages of kiriyai through the initiations.

1507.reading: Salokam and the rest are gained through sariyai and the rest: salokam and samipam come with sariyai, and on reaching the great world sarupam becomes the way, the form of the Supreme who is beyond the worlds.
1507.nuance: The traditional scheme pairs sariyai with salokam (his world), kiriyai with samipam (nearness), yoga with sarupam (his form) and jnana with sayujyam (union); the verse compresses it and seems to give two states to sariyai. மாலோகம் may be 'the great world' or Mal's (Vishnu's) world, and பாலோகம் இல்லா is obscure.

1508.reading: In kiriyai one's own mind is the temple; the samaya rule of mantra, then the special stage, then the third, coming to know the root, and the samaya consecration itself is samadhi.
1508.nuance: சமயம், விசேடம் and the third (traditionally நிருவாணம்) are read as the three grades of Saiva initiation (diksha), with அபிடேகம் as the consecration of a teacher. The verse names only சமயம், விசேடம், மூன்றாம் and சமயாபிடேகம், so this key is the tradition's. தன்மனங் கோயில் (the mind as temple) is the plainest claim.

links.note: 725 finds that the Highest has made the body his temple; 1508 makes the worshipper's own mind the temple in kiriyai. Both move the shrine inside the person.
